# TWA_Names.txt

Total War: Attila sound names (events, switches, states, buses, game parameters), one per line, from TheTollski's SoundbankEditor
(`SoundbankEditorCore/TWA_Names.txt`, github.com/TheTollski/SoundbankEditor, commit be3663c6, 2024-03-27), unchanged.

The repository has no licence file. TheTollski is on the WCE user's team; the user has permission to ship the list with WCE (user,
2026-11-19). Built into `wce_audio` (`include_str!`) as a source of names: a name's FNV-1 hash is the ID the banks use.
